source.name: HC Admiral official site: 'OLIMPBET продлевает партнерство с ХК «Адмирал» еще на три года'
source.quote: Букмекерская компания OLIMPBET и хоккейный клуб «Адмирал» объявили о продлении сотрудничества еще на три года.
source.note: Club announcement (26 Mar 2025): Olimpbet partnership, begun in 2024/25, extended for three more years, so it covers 2026-27. Current-season player portraits on the club site (https://hcadmiral.pro/team/players/, e.g. the portrait at /upload/iblock/006/0cy67b93hi3aidoggy4963uzqh5nik3b.JPG) show gold OLIMPBET lettering across the lower front of the black home jersey; re-verified in review on 2026-10-03 (portrait viewed directly).

checked.by: btj-researcher (OpenCode, model kimi-k3-abliterated, run by @Schnitzel); placement re-verified by Scout review (OpenCode, model kimi-k3-abliterated)

source.name: HC Admiral official photo gallery: '«Адмирал» - «Нефтехимик» — 3:5' (27 Sep 2026)
source.note: Match photo from the club's official gallery (Admiral–Neftekhimik, 27 Sep 2026; EXIF 2026-09-28) shows a small white patch with the yellow T-Bank 'T' logo sewn on the upper back of Admiral's black home jersey; image opened and patch confirmed in review on 2026-10-03 (Scout review, OpenCode, model kimi-k3-abliterated). T-Bank is a KHL general partner, listed in the league sponsor board on hcadmiral.pro ('Партнёры Фонбет Чемпионата КХЛ сезона 2026/2027'), so this is recorded as a league-partner placement.

summary: 2026-27 home kit. Olimpbet (OLIMPBET lettering across the lower front) per the club's 2025-03-26 partnership-extension announcement and current player portraits. A T-Bank league patch sits on the upper back in match photos. No sponsor logos seen on sleeves or pants in September 2026 match photos; helmet decals could not be identified, so the list is not marked complete.
